mutations.label: F1 the branch is INVERTED, so a stale bundle reports 'served build matches the source' and a matching bundle reports the stale-build warning. #722 exists because silence meant three things; saying the WRONG one is worse. `test_the_clean_path_is_the_else_of_the_stale_one` only checks the two messages' ORDER in the source and that an `else:` sits between them, which is unchanged
F2 the clean message's count is off by one, so 'all N declared route(s) are present' understates the bundle it just verified. `len(known_routes)` is still in the branch, which is all the test asks
mutations.find: "route(s) are present in the bundle.", len(known_routes))
mutations.replace: "route(s) are present in the bundle.", len(known_routes) - 1)

mutations.label: F3 the clean path is demoted to debug, so the signal #722 added vanishes from the log again and silence returns to meaning three things. EXPECTED CAUGHT -- `test_the_clean_path_is_info_not_warning` looks for `_LOG.info(` near the message
